summary: Thiomersal (thimerosal) is an ethylmercury preservative in multi-dose vaccine vials. WHO considers the amounts in vaccines safe.
indications: Used as a mercury-containing preservative (vaccines, eye drops) in combination products; it has no therapeutic indication of its own

dosage.d: No therapeutic dose; present as a mercury-containing preservative (vaccines, eye drops)
dosage.n: The dose is that of the product's active ingredients

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Formulation role only; no therapeutic action at the amounts used.
preg: No specific concern at excipient concentrations
lact: No specific concern at excipient concentrations
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
refs: World Health Organization: guidelines and position papers
footer: StewardMD-authored DRAFT. No US, Canadian or EU regulatory label exists for this molecule; AI-drafted from the references above and awaiting clinician review. Doses are typical published ranges, not a product label: check the Indian product's own pack insert before prescribing.
